regions.today: Tuesday will bring a mix of sunny spells and scattered passing showers. Feeling fresher with highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees in a moderate to fresh northwesterly wind
regions.tonight: Showers will become well scattered with long dry clear spells developing. Lowest temperatures of 9 to 12 degrees in a moderating westerly wind.
regions.tomorrow: Wednesday will be a dry day generally with a mix of cloud and some sunny spells. However, thickening cloud will produce the odd spot of drizzle later in the day. Highest temperatures of 16 to 18 degrees, best values further east, all in a mostly moderate west to southwest breeze, freshening later.
